# State Integrity Check — 2026-05-04

## Summary

✅ All critical systems healthy. No action required.

## Detailed Findings

### Active Job Session
✅ **Healthy** — Current job session is running, no orphaned references

### Job-Topic Mappings  
✅ **Healthy** — No stale topic references detected

### State File Bloat
⚠️ **Monitor** — Ledgers growing steadily but not yet problematic
- `telegram-messages.jsonl`: 3.3 MB (expected growth)
- `job-runs.jsonl`: 7.2 MB, 23,926 entries (~435/day)
- `skipped-runs.jsonl`: 1.1 MB, 13,004 entries (~464/day)

### Ledger Retention Policy
✅ **Healthy** — All entries < 55 days old
- No pruning needed now
- **Future action**: Implement 90-day retention before ledgers reach 20 MB

### Server Health
✅ **Nominal** — Minor degradation (merge conflict auto-resolution) is expected

### Handoff Notes
✅ **Fresh** — 8 notes updated today, all within 7 days

### Config-Reality Alignment
✅ **Aligned** — All configurations match runtime state
